overview.about: The BMW Ladies Championship is the LPGA's flagship event in South Korea, a country that produces many of the tour's biggest stars. Played near the port city of Busan, it draws enormous, knowledgeable galleries and a world-class field.
overview.nextEvent: The next BMW Ladies Championship is played at LPGA International Busan. Home fans turn out in force to watch Korea's many top players compete on the LPGA's Korean stop.

airportTransfer: Confirm the tournament's current transport guidance for LPGA International Busan before booking an airport transfer.

flightTip: Check the course access plan for LPGA International Busan; airport and road times are not interchangeable on tournament days.
stayGuidance: A base in Busan keeps everyday services nearby; check the last leg to LPGA International Busan before reserving accommodation.
bookingAdvice: Compare total price, cancellation terms and the route to the course before committing to tournament-week travel.
